SANS 300.title: Introductory Sanskrit
SANS 300.description: Basic vocabulary and most important grammatical features of classical Sanskrit. Useful to students of South Asian history, culture, languages, philosophies, and religions, and of linguistics and classics.

SANS 301.title: Introductory Sanskrit I
SANS 301.description: Basic vocabulary and most important grammatical features of classical Sanskrit. Useful to students of South Asian history, culture, languages, philosophies, and religions, and of linguistics and classics. No prior proficiency in Sanskrit required.

SANS 302.title: Introductory Sanskrit II
SANS 302.description: Continuation of SANS 301. Recommended pre-requisite: SANS 301.

SANS 400.title: Intermediate Sanskrit
SANS 400.description: Advanced grammar and selected readings. Recommended pre-requisites: one of SANS 300, SANS 302.

SANS 401.title: Intermediate Sanskrit I
SANS 401.description: Advanced grammar and selected readings. Recommended pre-requisites: one of SANS 300, SANS 302.

SANS 402.title: Intermediate Sanskrit II
SANS 402.description: Continuation of SANS 401. Recommended pre-requisite: SANS 401.

SANS 450.title: Further Readings in Sanskrit
SANS 450.description: Study of selected texts belonging to a particular period (e.g., Vedic) or representing a specific branch of kavya (poetic literature) or sastra (technical-philosophical literature). Recommended pre-requisites: one of SANS 200, SANS 202, SANS 400, SANS 402.
